requirements.title: Service and repair contract: definition and qualifying conditions

criteria: Residential home improvement work for homeowner or tenant
Customer-initiated request
transaction_types: Service and repair contract
thresholds: Contract price <= $750 (verify)

required_behavior: A service and repair contract is an agreement between a licensed contractor (or its salesperson) and a homeowner or tenant for a home improvement where the contract amount is seven hundred fifty dollars ($750) or less (B&P 7159.10(a)(1)(A)).

The prospective buyer must have initiated contact with the contractor to request the work; the contractor must not sell goods or services beyond those reasonably necessary to take care of the particular problem that caused the buyer to call; and no payment may be due, or accepted, until the work is completed (B&P 7159.10(a)(1)(B)-(D), (a)(2)).

The contract must include the items in B&P 7159.10(d)-(e), including: contractor name, business address and license number; the date signed; the CGL and workers' compensation notices; the 'Service and Repair' heading (10-point bold); the 12-point bold 'Notice to the Buyer' signed and dated by the buyer; 'Contract Price' or 'Estimated Contract Price' in dollars and cents; the project/materials/equipment description; the replaced-parts statement and checkbox; 'Amount of Service Charge' with the one-service-charge statement, if charged; and the 'YOUR RIGHTS TO CANCEL BEFORE WORK BEGINS' notice.

If any condition fails (e.g., price exceeds $750, contractor-initiated sale, goods or services beyond those needed for the particular problem, payment due or accepted before the work is completed, or additional work raises the total above $750), the job must be documented as a home improvement contract under B&P 7159 (7159.10(b): subdivisions (c), (d) and (e) of 7159 apply, including Civil Code 1689.6/1689.7 rescission rights, regardless of price).

Volteira may offer a service-and-repair template only when the price is <= $750, customer-initiated is recorded, no payment is requested or accepted before the work is completed, and no other condition fails; change orders that push the total above $750 must convert the job to the 7159 template.
